info.title: Wickd.Cli
info.description: CLI tool for deterministic backtest plumbing and Smart Money Concepts structure journaling in the WickdAlgo platform.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the Wickd appsettings.json file.

commands.name: fetch
commands.description: Fetch and cache historical candles for one market and timeframe.

options.name: --market
options.description: Canonical market ID from markets.json.

options.name: --timeframe
options.description: Candle timeframe, such as 5m.

options.name: --from
options.description: Inclusive UTC start time for the requested candle window.

options.name: --to
options.description: Exclusive UTC end time for the requested candle window.

options.name: --alias
options.description: Optional friendly dataset alias saved for this fetched range.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing dataset alias. [default: False]

commands.name: backtest
commands.description: Run a deterministic backtest for one market and timeframe.

options.name: --market
options.description: Canonical market ID from markets.json.

options.name: --timeframe
options.description: Candle timeframe, such as 5m.

options.name: --from
options.description: Inclusive UTC start time for the requested candle window.

options.name: --to
options.description: Exclusive UTC end time for the requested candle window.

options.name: --dataset
options.description: Dataset alias previously saved by fetch --alias.

options.name: --run-id
options.description: Optional run ID assigned to replayed backtest candles.

commands.name: manage
commands.description: Manage local dataset aliases, cached datasets, and run outputs.

commands.name: datasets
commands.description: List and delete dataset aliases and cached candle files.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a dataset alias and optionally its cached candle file.

options.name: --alias
options.description: Dataset alias to delete.

options.name: --delete-cache
options.description: Also delete the cached candle file when no remaining alias references it. [default: False]

commands.name: aliases
commands.description: List and delete dataset aliases and cached candle files.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a dataset alias and optionally its cached candle file.

options.name: --alias
options.description: Dataset alias to delete.

options.name: --delete-cache
options.description: Also delete the cached candle file when no remaining alias references it. [default: False]

commands.name: runs
commands.description: List and delete local backtest run outputs.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a local backtest run output directory.

options.name: --run-id
options.description: Run ID whose output directory should be deleted.

options.name: --force
options.description: Confirm recursive deletion of the run output directory. [default: False]

commands.name: path
commands.description: Print the active Wickd appsettings path.

options.name: --run-id
options.description: Run ID whose journals should be analyzed.
